Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and follow the example there.

Goal
* Please format all variables and constants.

* Please either remove the example (as an example is already shown in the Example section), or add working to explain how the output is achieved. The current explanation is inadequate.

Input
* Please follow the example to write this section, including line numbers, variable names, variable types and descriptions.

Output
* Please follow the example to write this section, including line numbers, variable names, variable types and descriptions.

Constraints
* Please format all variables.

* Please reduce the upper bounds to be as close to the actual bounds in the cases as possible.

Stub generator
* Please reduce 200000 to the revised upper bound used in the Constraints section.

Cases
* Every test and its validator are currently the same. Pair 1 is even the same as Pair 3. Please revise the cases, so that every case is different while ensuring that each test and its validator covers the same scenario with slightly different inputs and outputs.

Thanks.
